T: Two cops. One shower. Zero patience.
D: Two rival LA cops are framed and have to break out of prison together.
P: Serve the mains when the armoured RV rolls out.
S: Bologna, yellow mustard and American cheese on white bread, griddled in butter under a weight until crisp.
Marinated beef grilled hot and chopped small, in warm corn tortillas with onion, coriander, salsa verde and lime.

Cold cooked prawns on crisp cucumber rounds with sriracha lime mayo and coriander, served beside mini tomato and basil bruschetta. Peel 16 cooked king prawns and halve lengthways. Cut 2 Lebanese cucumbers into thick rounds. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 2 tsp sriracha and lime zest. Top each cucumber round with a dot of mayo, a prawn half and a coriander leaf. Slice half a baguette thin, brush with oil and toast at 200C for 6 minutes, rub with garlic and top with diced tomato, basil, salt and olive oil.
M: Rib eye dry-brined, seared hard, basted with butter and thyme, pulled at 54C, rested, sliced.
the slop they break out to get away from

Beef and pork meatloaf with a sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, thick slices on buttery mash with minted peas. Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 60g breadcrumbs, 1 egg, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and salt. Shape into a loaf in a lined tin. Mix 80ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp vinegar, spread over and bake at 180C for 60 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes, mash with 60g butter and 100ml hot milk. Cook 300g frozen peas 3 minutes and toss with butter and mint. Rest the loaf 10 minutes before slicing.

Vanilla cupcakes baked at 180C for 18 minutes, piped with pink buttercream and covered in sprinkles.
K: Tango, the best-dressed cop in LA

Rye whiskey stirred with sweet vermouth and bitters until ice cold, strained into chilled coupes with a dark cocktail cherry. Chill 4 coupe glasses in the freezer. Fill a jug with ice and add 200ml rye whiskey, 80ml sweet vermouth and 8 dashes aromatic bitters. Stir for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into the coupes and drop a cocktail cherry into each. Twist a strip of orange peel over the top.

s.note: Crisp butter griddled white bread with devon, cheese and mustard.
s.how: Spread 8 slices white bread with 20g yellow mustard. Layer 120g devon and 80g American-style cheese between the slices to make four sandwiches. Butter the outside using 30g softened butter. Griddle over medium heat under a weighted pan for 3 minutes each side until crisp and the cheese melts. Cut each into fingers to share.

s.note: Chopped grilled steak tacos with onion, coriander and salsa verde.
s.how: Marinate 500g skirt steak in the juice of 2 limes, 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin for 1 hour. Grill hot for 3 minutes a side, rest and chop small. Warm 12 small corn tortillas and fill with the steak, diced white onion, coriander and salsa verde, lime wedges on the side.

m.note: Dry brined steak basted with butter, thyme and garlic.
m.how: Pat dry four 200g rib eye steaks, season with 1 tsp fine salt and refrigerate uncovered for 4 to 12 hours to dry-brine. Heat a heavy pan with 1 tbsp neutral oil until hot. Sear the steaks hard for about 3 minutes per side in batches. Lower the heat and add 50g butter, 4 thyme sprigs and 3 crushed garlic cloves. Baste for 1 to 2 minutes. Remove at 54°C in the centre for medium rare, or cook longer if preferred. Rest for 8 minutes, slice and spoon over the pan butter.

w.note: Vanilla cupcakes with pink buttercream and a generous coat of sprinkles.
w.how: Beat 80g softened butter with 80g caster sugar until pale. Beat in 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla extract. Fold in 100g self-raising flour and 40ml milk. Divide between 8 cupcake cases and bake at 180°C conventional for 18 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool completely. Beat 60g softened butter with 120g icing sugar and 1 tsp milk until fluffy; tint with a little pink food colouring. Pipe onto the cupcakes and cover with 20g sprinkles. Serve two small cupcakes each.
